entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, I'm exhausted... Haven't ran like[n]that in a while...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Talk about feeling the burn, right?[n]My legs are killin' me...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But hey, you can still run like that even[n]after a long break? Not bad at all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You been workin' out behind my back?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I knew it. Probably been runnin' around[n]like crazy in the Metaverse.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Geez, you're hardcore! I gotta keep up!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Seriously? Guess that old saying was[n]true. Somethin' like, uh... "Still waters[n]run really freakin' fast."

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Damn, if you start taking this seriously...[n]I guess I better catch up fast.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: *pant* Holy... crap... My legs're shakin'...[n]Don't collapse on your way home,[n]man...
